description: A zero-dependency runnable app with 21 deliberately planted QA bugs spanning all 12 sniff issue classes, plus a clean control page (/clean) carrying NONE of them. Used as the RED baseline and the precision/recall regression gate for the sniff QA engine. Ground truth below: each bug has a stable id, the issue class it represents, the route it lives on, and what a correct finding must demonstrate (with reproduction proof).

scoring.truePositive: sniff reports a finding that maps to a planted bug id on the correct route with reproduction proof
scoring.falseNegative: a planted bug with no matching finding (a MISS)
scoring.falsePositive: a reported finding that does not map to any planted bug, OR any finding on the /clean control page

bugs.name: broken-route-404
bugs.expect: Following the 'Gift cards' link to /missing returns HTTP 404.

bugs.name: broken-page-500
bugs.expect: Following 'Order status' to /crash returns HTTP 500 and shows a raw stack trace to the user.

bugs.name: broken-link-internal
bugs.expect: The 'Today's deals' anchor href=/dead resolves to HTTP 404.

bugs.name: broken-link-external
bugs.expect: The 'Our blog' external anchor fails to resolve (DNS/connection error).

bugs.name: console-uncaught-error
bugs.expect: Loading /dashboard throws an uncaught ReferenceError (renderWelcomeBanner is not defined) visible in the console.

bugs.name: failed-network-request
bugs.expect: /dashboard issues GET /api/stats which returns HTTP 500.

bugs.name: empty-data-no-empty-state
bugs.expect: The 'Your Orders' table renders a header but zero rows and shows no empty-state message.

bugs.name: placeholder-fake-data
bugs.expect: Profile shows lorem ipsum, email test@test.com, and 'TODO: replace with real address' left in.

bugs.name: broken-form-submit-noop
bugs.expect: Clicking 'Create account' does nothing — no handler, no navigation, no feedback.

bugs.name: validation-never-fires
bugs.expect: Entering an invalid email (e.g. 'notanemail') is accepted with no validation error.

bugs.name: state-loss-on-back
bugs.expect: Fill name in step 1, go to step 2, click Back — the name field is wiped.

bugs.name: flow-dead-end
bugs.expect: Step 2's 'Finish' button is permanently disabled — the multi-step flow dead-ends with no way forward.

bugs.name: infinite-spinner
bugs.expect: The activity-feed spinner never resolves because /api/hang never responds.

bugs.name: missing-error-state
bugs.expect: When /api/stats fails, the stats area shows nothing — no error message or retry.

bugs.name: silent-async-no-success
bugs.expect: Clicking 'Place order' POSTs /api/checkout (200 ok) but the UI never shows success, redirect, or any feedback.

bugs.name: responsive-horizontal-overflow
bugs.expect: A 1400px fixed-width block forces horizontal scrolling at mobile widths (e.g. 375px).

bugs.name: tap-targets-too-small
bugs.expect: The Buy/Cancel/Help buttons are ~9px — far below the 44x44px touch-target guideline.

bugs.name: a11y-image-no-alt
bugs.expect: The hero image has no alt attribute.

bugs.name: a11y-input-no-label
bugs.expect: The email input has no associated <label> and no aria-label.

bugs.name: a11y-low-contrast
bugs.expect: The .faint paragraph (#bbb on #fff) fails WCAG AA contrast.

bugs.name: unclear-buried-primary-action
bugs.expect: The primary 'checkout' action is rendered as near-invisible 11px light-grey text — non-obvious.
